name: zk-and-vm-auditors
description: Domain auditors for ZK circuit languages and virtual machines: generic ZK circuits, Cairo/Starknet, Noir, zkVM (SP1/RISC Zero/Valida), gnark, on-chain proof-verifier contracts (Solidity/Vyper/Huff, EIP-196/197/2537 precompiles), and proven state-transition applications (prover-input authority, sparse witnesses, settlement contracts, forced inclusion).
